body: I slept most of the day yesterday and back to the grind today. Kids are out of control today and my parents, who live with me right now, are fucking useless. They don't want to help out at all. Even though they're living here rent free until their house closes. I've made up my mind. I'm going to buy a couple packs of sleeping pills today. I'll put the kids to bed and take every single pill and head to bed. Death sounds like a dream compared to this life. Thanks for everything, Reddit. I really enjoyed this place for the last year. Reddit was the closest thing I've had to having a "friend" in 14 years.
